ending.final.arrive: the deepest part of Yokotank's Fortress...
What on earth is in here?
ending.final.welcome: {player}: What the heck do you think you're doing?! Stealing everybody's food! And on top of that, tons of people are dead! Innocent people!
Yokotank: We've only just met, and that's how you start? Well, fine. Either way, it has nothing to do with me.
{player}: What do you mean, nothing to do with you?! You're a murderer! And you're human!
ending.final.human: Yokotank: I used to be human too, once...
ending.final.backstory: I was an ordinary human. A person.
I spent my days with everyone, and I had friends.
But there was just one thing about me that was different from everyone else.
One day, I developed a binge-eating disorder.
I want to eat... I want to eat... Wherever I was, whatever I did, a voice kept saying: I want to eat, I want to eat.
Even when I wasn't hungry, I couldn't stop eating... And I kept getting fatter and fatter.
My friends started hating me, I couldn't afford food, and I couldn't find a job to pay back the money I'd borrowed for it.
I wanted to die.
Then I wondered: couldn't I do research to cure binge eating?
Before the disorder, I'd been studying science at university, so I had some knowledge, and my grades were excellent, so I had the skills to build a robot or two by myself.
So I thought I would examine every gene and every cell in my body, one by one, and control the signals sent to my brain, to cure the binge eating artificially.
For years, I kept researching, without caring how much money it cost.
And then, it was finished.
I was overjoyed, and set out to cure my binge eating.
But the robot had just one parameter that was incomplete.

The robot, running an incomplete program, rewrote the wrong parts of my genes, and erased, warped and modified unrelated cells. The binge eating wasn't cured. Instead, my body turned into something like a monster's.
Looking like this, nobody would give me anything, wherever I went.
Restaurants sent me away, children slapped me, and I spent every day alone at home.
And then I thought: people who take food away from me aren't needed in this world.
And that food should exist for me alone.
ending.final.reply: {player}: So you've been through a lot too.
But your way of thinking is wrong.
ending.final.erase: So I'm gonna fix your mistake myself.
Yokotank: I never change what I've decided, what I've thought through. Whatever you say, I will have all the food for myself.
And anyone who gets in the way of that plan...
ending.final.true_power: Yokotank: You're too much for me. It seems the time has come to show my true power.
Now I'm going to beat you to a pulp, completely.
ending.final.time_bomb: Yokotank: Do you know what I just did?
That's right, I set a time bomb. I gave it quite a long timer, but if we don't settle this soon, you and I will both be blown sky-high. If we're going to die, let's die together, shall we?
ending.final.machine: Yokotank: And while I'm at it! I also built a fun machine that chases you and shoots you full of holes. Isn't it great? Today's its very first run!
{player}: You jerk! Quit building all this weird junk! Why don't you build a robot that makes you feel full instead?! Huh?!
Yokotank: Hee hee hee hee hee hee. Well, before the bomb goes off, I'll probably have eaten you up, nice and tasty. As a special treat, I'll even eat you raw.
{player}: No way am I getting eaten. No way am I dying!
I'm... going back to my friends!
ending.final.last_fight: {player}: Let's end this. I... don't want to fight anymore!
Yokotank: Very well. This is my last struggle, and you will be my last meal!

ending.stop_bomb: {player}: Not yet. It's not over yet.
I'm going to stop the bomb. I don't want to die!
{player}: Hmmm, which wire am I supposed to cut, and how? I have no idea.
Yokotank: Wait! If you cut the wrong one, it'll explode!
ending.bad.flee: Yokotank: Calm down! What good are you if you don't calm down?!
Yokotank: You run. I'll stay here.
Everything I've done is unforgivable. Fighting you, I finally understood that. I don't know why, but you made me understand that hating humans gets me nowhere.
It's all my fault. So I'll disappear here!
{player}: ...Thank you. It was fun. I'll never forget you as long as I live.
ending.bad.remorse: I killed so many innocent people.
Yokotank... Yamijin... the Gakishonen... Did I really have to kill them?
What did I kill all those people for?
Before the bomb went off, why did I choose to run away all by myself?
That's right. Yokotank and the others are calling me. Maybe I should go back too... to Yokotank and Yamijin...
ending.bad.never_returned: After that, {player} never returned to the friends back home. Nobody knows what became of {player}...
ending.good.refuse: Yokotank: Calm down! What good are you if you don't calm down?!
Yokotank: You run. I'll stay here.
Everything I've done is unforgivable. Fighting you, I finally understood that. I don't know why, but you made me understand that hating humans gets me nowhere.
It's all my fault. So I'll disappear here!
When I leave this place, I'm leaving with you! Otherwise I'll die right here!
{player}: Sure, maybe what you did was wrong.
But I took a whole lot of lives to beat you, too.
I'm a murderer through and through. And no murderer's gonna abandon another murderer!
Yokotank: ...Thank you. If we can still make it, let's get out together.
{player}: Dammit! Looks like we won't make it! The door's on fire!
Yokotank: Dammit... is this the end...
ending.good.cruiser: {player}: It's a Grand Cruiser! A big one!
Yokotank: Didn't you destroy all of them?
{player}: I thought I did! Anyway, get on! We'll blast out of here on that thing!
ending.good.yamijin: Hey! The one riding it is...!

Yamijin: Kweeeee-hee-hee-hee-hee-heeeee! Hurry up and let's go, nyaaaaan! I don't wanna die, nyaaaaan! {player} didn't kill me, so now I know how precious life is, so much it hurts! We're all getting out of here alive! Kweeee-hee-hee-hee-hee-heeeeeee! Kreeree-kreeeeee!
ending.good.saved: Yokotank: Looks like we made it!
Yamijin: We did it, nya! I'm a genius! Kweeee-hee-hee-hee-hee-heeeeee! Kreeree-kreeee!
Yamijin: Well... just returning the favour!
Yokotank: Shut up! That might be fine for you two, but why did I get saved?!
You two might be fine, you've got talent, but look at me. How am I supposed to live from now on?!
Just come live at my house.
You two won't turn on me anymore, right? Besides, it's been proven that I'm stronger than both of you now!
Yokotank and Yamijin: Thank you very much, master! We are so grateful! We will follow you for the rest of our lives! We will protect you with all our might, master!
{player}: Whoa, whoa. Knock it off with the master stuff. It's way too much. Ha ha ha ha ha ha!
Now. Let's go home. To our home!!
ending.good.home: {player}: Come on, instead of hero this and hero that, I'd be happy if you just said welcome home!
Friend 3: Shut up! We're so happy we don't know what to do with ourselves! Get in here already!
{player}: Hang on a sec. I brought some guests.
Yokotank and Yamijin: Hello. We are Yokotank and Yamijin, and from today on we will be living here. We look forward to staying with you.
ending.good.guests: Friend 3: What the heck are you talking about?!
Friend 2: Yeah! They're enemies! E! Ne! Mies!
{player}: It's fine, it's fine. They lost to me, so if they try anything funny, I'll beat them up!
Friend 1: And who's that next to you?
{player}: Oh, this? Apparently it's called Yokotank.
Yokotank: Hey! Don't call me an it!
{player}: What are you, parrots? Copying everything he says.
{player}: Come on, don't all jump on the bandwagon!
Yamijin: I'm not jumping on anything, you know?
Friends 1, 2 and 3: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!
Anyway, it seems these two creatures... er, people... get to live in this house now.
ending.good.charm: {player}: Hey, I just heard a weird sound.
Friend 1: Someone's been charmed. Who could it be?
Friend 2: What? Seriously? No way! The one for me is
ending.good.charm2: Friend 3: Huh? With a beep in the way, we can't tell who you mean.
ending.good.heart: {player}: Oh! I think Yamijin's heart just cracked a little.
Friend 2: Huh? So what if it breaks? He's not my type at all.
ending.good.heart2: {player}: That's 2 points of damage this time.

Friend 2: Besides, after controlling all those people, falling for someone? What's wrong with you? You can stay in the house, but don't try anything weird. And quit talking like a cat, will you? Honestly.
ending.good.heart_broken: {player}: Yamijin's heart shattered to pieces! Game over!!
Friend 3: All right, today we celebrate! Celebrate! Tell us what happened later. Let's party!
After that, everyone had a wonderful, fun time...
ending.good.epilogue: {player}: This was the right thing, wasn't it?
What I did... wasn't wrong, was it?
Friend 3: That's right. You saved the world from a weird ambition.
Friend 2: You saved lots of people.
{player}: But I took a lot of lives.
I think every life has meaning.
So you shouldn't just go and wipe out lives as you please.
I think it's the same for every life, whatever it is.
But murder and suicide knock that order off its rails.
And instead of taking someone's life to the station called happiness, it takes them to stations like sadness, or anger, or loneliness.
I learned a lot of things on this adventure.
From now on, let's all have fun together, so that nothing like this ever happens again.
Friend 1: Yeah. Our fun life is coming back again, isn't it?
Friend 2: And we've got new friends too! Let's enjoy it!
Friend 3: That's great and all, but...
how are we gonna pay for all the food?
Friends 1, 2, 3 and {player}: Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!!
The laughter of the four of them echoed through the house forever and ever...

Our Great Adventure: Hidden Command 2
With this hidden command, you can do some outrageous things.
Or rather, you can stand at the very top of the world of Our Great Adventure.
However, I trust you understand that a mean author like me would never, ever just tell you straight out.
Below is a cipher.
Whoever solves it may call themselves the King of Our Great Adventure.
! ! r o h t u a / e h t
/ m a / I / ! ! e d o m
/ t s e t / r o h t u A

Once you have entered it, the following controls become available.
Please understand that the author takes no responsibility for anything that happens as a result of using this.
What exactly happens, you will find out by trying it.
The Escape key, Shift+Tab, and the F2 key.
There are only these three, but you who solved the cipher will surely see right away what terrible things these three keys can cause.
For when you solve the cipher, you become a being more evil than Yokotank, and you gain freedom...
Our Great Adventure: Hidden Command 1
Using the Buster Blade.
With this hidden command, you will be able to blow enemies to smithereens with the Buster Blade, every time.
If you hold Enter while swinging the Buster Blade, the enemy is knocked flying as hard as possible and then can't move anymore.
After that, you mix it up bit by bit and go DEYAAAAAH!
By the way, legend has it that it doesn't work in No Future mode.

Whether you enter from the Flame Town side or from the Unknown Land,
the directions and step counts are given from the spot where you first bump your back into the entrance with a "boom", so right after entering Flame Mountain, back up until you hear the "boom".
When entering from the Unknown Land, read from the bottom line upwards, and swap U with D and L with R.
If you follow this route, you never take a wrong step, and you can cross the mountain in either direction.
 U means press the up arrow, D the down arrow, l the left arrow and r the right arrow.
You can also explore for crumbling ground by using a weapon.
And you can repair crumbled ground by using the Slingshot.
When doing that, hold down the Control key.

Our Great Adventure: The Truth About the Last Dungeon
The last dungeon starts straight away with a fight against Yamijin.
Right after the Yamijin fight, you are around 174,304.
If you kill Yamijin after the fight, you cannot see the good ending.
From here, go up one, then left, then up as far as you can, and there is a door.
Through the door, you are at 172,313.
Next, go up, right, up, and some windows block the way, so smash them as you go.
Go to 174,333 and then right, and there is a window, so smash it.
At 186,333, three Beam Machines appear.
From 186,337 on, it is an open area.
There are doors at 180,346, 200,340 and 187,349.
Go through the door at 180,346 and there is a key lying at 173,349, so pick it up.
Go through the door at 200,340 and there are lots of sweet buns,
but if you destroy the one at 212,340 instead of picking it up, you can go down. It's a waste of one sweet bun, but oh well.
There is a key lying at 212,336, so pick it up.
Ignore 211,341.
The door at 187,349 won't open without the two keys above, so you need to pick them up first.
Go through it, then up, right, down, right, up, right, down, and at 193,351 there is a door on the right where you can get some healing items.
Without going that far, partway along the first path going up, at 187,353, there is a path to the left.
Follow it left, then up, and there is a door at 185,356.
Go in and straight up, and there is another door at 185,370.
Go through that door and a little way up, and you fight the mini-boss kissenon.
Go up, and from 185,377 on there is an open area that is a bit cluttered on the right.
In the top left corner of this area there are two items.
There is a door at 194,389. Go in facing up, and it opens out in front of you, with a path continuing to the bottom right.
At 196,382 there is a door leading right.
At 196,377 there is a door leading down.
Both lead to the room on the right.
That room only lets you go right through the door at 199,380, and there is nothing in it.
Through the door, there is a path going up from 208,380. If you go up, there is a door on the right. If you go straight on without going up, there is also a door on the right.
The upper door takes you there directly, and the door at the far right takes you through a small room with a door out to the right, and you come out in the same room on the right.
In this room, press Enter facing right at 218,382 to start the ball dodging.
In the area where the ball dodging ends, poking 222,384 sends you back to the place nine lines up from here.
At 223,382 there is a door out to the right. Go through it, and
at 227,382 and 228,382 there are doors facing down. Either one leads to the same area.
Here, markers of four colours are scattered around, and there are doors all over the place.
If you step on 239,379, something seems to happen, and you hear a big boooom. Maybe it's better to step on it?
Past the upward exits at 229,390 and 230,390: game over.
Past the upward exit at 234,390: game over.
Past the downward exit at 230,370: game over.
Past the downward exit at 236,370, you can pick up some shards of light.
Past the upward exit at 240,390, going up to 240,398, there is a wide path that turns back to the right.
Partway along this path, at 243,371, there is a door facing right.
Go through the door, straight right, cut down the sabon tree, pick up the fruit, and go to the end, and at 252,371 there is a door facing up.
Go through it and smash the windows to the left and right of 252,380. On the right there are healing items and a pointless(?) window,
and on the left there is a door, and at the very back, at 245,398, there is a futon that works just like a hotel.
From 252,380, keep going up to the end and go through the door at 252,387,
then go up one more and you fight Kuroro.
When that's done, cut down the sabon tree to clear the way to the next place.
Go down, then right, and at the end, at 259,388, there is a door.
Go through it and up until you bump into something, and a path stretches to the left. On the right is something like a small open area.
At 255,390 there is a Warp Panel going up, but unless you unequip your weapon, you can't get through properly.
Also, once you've been through it and come back from this warp spot: without a weapon equipped, you go back to where the Kuroro fight was; with a weapon equipped, I haven't checked where you end up.
At 255,397 there is a Warp Panel, and here too you must not have a weapon equipped.
From 255,401, there is a complicated open area on the right.
Go to its right edge, and look for a way up by moving left and right a little at a time. When you get up to 264,407, you hear a door to the left, so head that way.
Go through the door at 263,407, and at 257,407 there is a three-way junction.
At 254,407 there is a door leading left, and at the back you get a little hint.
At 257,412 there is a door facing up, and it is a tricky contraption just like the hint in the room on the left.
Go through upward three times, and
at 257,418 there is a window on the left and a door above.
Go through the upper door, and at 255,420 there is a door facing up that takes you out at 255,422. On the way back, go down through the door at 255,422, and 257,420 has turned into a window, so you have to break it, just once.
Or smash the window on the left, go left to the end and then up, and at 255,420 there is a door facing up that takes you out at 255,422. On the way back, go down through the door at 255,422, down to 255,418, then right to the end and face down.
Do either of the two lines above and go down through three doors to get back to 257,412, but where you actually want to go next is 255,422.
From 255,422 on, it is a pretty big open area.
At the right edge, at 272,423, there is a door. Inside is a straight path, and at 282,423 there is a mini-boss fight.
Go up, and at 272,428 there is a door. Inside is a straight path, and at 281,428 there is a mini-boss fight.
Coming up from the bottom left, at 241,428, there is a door. Inside is a straight path, and at 230,428 there is a mini-boss fight.
Here, there is a futon at 234,428 where you can rest.
Go up, and at 241,436 there is a door. Inside is a straight path, and at 226,436 there is a mini-boss fight.
Enter the four paths above in any order: each has two mini-boss fights except the last one, which has one, and once you've been somewhere, the mini-boss fights there are gone.
Once you finish the seven mini-boss fights in a row, you can go through the door at 255,440. It's the only door left.
This place is full of dressers, tables and vases, and over on the right there are some sweet buns.
Go in, move up until you bump into something, then go five to the left, and there is a door at 250,446.
Go through this door, go up the wide room until you bump into something,
then press Enter at the far right, at 275,450, for some ball dodging.
Here, when two balls come flying, you have to pick the direction that dodges both of them, and the balls come faster and faster.
When you finish the ball dodging, you are at 275,446. Move down and right to 276,430, and there is a door facing right.
Go through the door. At 280,432 there is a machine with three buttons. Check your ball count with the blue button, and fire 255 slingshot balls into this machine. Then the door at 283,436 opens, but note that once you go through it, you can't save until the very end.
Yokotank is here. Beat him in two fights in a row and you get to see the ending.
Here are Yokotank's attack patterns.
Yokotank, round 1
Attack: Punch. Close-range attack. Used at random. 120 damage.
Attack: Earthquake. Hits the whole field. Used at random. Has a charge-up. 50 damage times 5, fast.
Yokotank, round 2
Attack: Punch. Close-range attack. Used at random. 100 damage.
Attack: Earthquake. Hits the whole field. Used at random. Has a charge-up. 50 damage times 10, super fast.
Attack: Total Beatdown. Close-range attack. Used at random. Short charge-up. 60 damage times 9.
Attack: Iron Ball. Long-range attack. Used at random. Has a charge-up. 200 damage, knocks you away.
Attack: Crunch Munch. Close-range attack. Used when right next to you. Has a charge-up. Instant death. You can't even hear your dying scream.
Warp: warps to a random position. Used at random.
Iron Belly: takes no damage for a while. Used at random. Makes the laser move faster.
Attack: Laser. Chases the player. Fires when right next to you. Has a charge-up. Damage is 20% of your max HP.
This is for Normal mode. In other modes it is beefed up accordingly.
 When you clear everything, a special file, replay_tempsavedata.dat, is created. Without renaming it, start play.exe and let it generate save data for the replay,
and from then on you enter the replay using the generated save data.
After the replay starts, you can change the mode at the desk at 10,10 in the storeroom of your home.

Once you open the computer, read all the mail and documents, then close it.
After that, poke the bookshelf at 69,240, and Yamijin comes out and gets beaten all on his own.
Also, above 34,139 there is a dresser. Smash it to open a path to a small room where you can get items.
If you go back to 58,232, instead of telling you the computer password, it now warps you out of the room, but you still have to insert the key.
The warp takes you to 77,242.
From here, go right, up, right, each time until you bump into something, and above 99,272 is the entrance to Flame Town.
Other than that, there should be nothing but a huge open space, though it's a bit convoluted.
At 58,242 there is a Warp Panel that warps you back to just past Arkhaia City. It takes you to 75,200.
Our Great Adventure: Crystal City
Going down from 1,50, there is the entrance to your home.
In front of your home it is wide, and if you go up to 52, you can go straight along a path to the right. This path widens here and there, with places where you can get items.
At 33,52, paths stretch up and down, and there are houses both ways.
After talking to the person in the house whose entrance is to the right of 34,54,
go into the house whose entrance is to the right of 33,49, and you fight the first mini-boss, Powerful Gakishonen.
By the way, if you attack the person in the lower house, something funny happens, so give it a try.
The whip is especially hilarious.
After that, go back into the house at 34,54 and talk to the person, and you can go out the back door, straight to the right, to the other side.
To come back from that side, go left through the entrance at 45,54 and straight on to the left.
At 53,55 there is a strange switch. Pressing it makes monsters come out, and after the very first fight, you get the Short Sword.
The entrance going down from 47,52 is a hotel. Staying there fully restores your HP and Stamina, and there is also the same sofa that was outside your room at home.
From 56,52 to the right is Friendship Park. At first there are children scattered all over, and one(?) adult.
This park isn't just a big open space. The paths are a bit complicated, and there are people at the following places.
59,54: a child.
61,45: a child.
62,52: a child.
65,55: a child.
66,50: a child.
71,53: a man smoking a cigarette.
Stand next to anyone in the park and talk five(?) times in total, and you fight the second mini-boss, a Big Slime,
and then the smoking man turns into a police officer and the places where the children were turn into rice balls.
After beating the Big Slime, talk to the police officer.
Then go to 50,67. Above it is the entrance to a house, so go in and
talk to the person at 49,73. There is an event where you chase Yamijin by mashing the right arrow key, so keep mashing fast so that Yamijin's voice doesn't disappear off the right edge.
After that, you are back where the house's resident is, so go to the police officer at 71,52 again and talk to him, and
to the right of 54,67, to the right of where the house entrance was earlier, a manhole appears that warps you to the Mystery Building.
Go through this manhole, finish the Mystery Building event, and bring the child home to the house whose entrance is above 50,67, and
you can leave town through the upward exit at 47,78.
The mini-boss fight is gone, but the manhole that warps you to the Mystery Building is still there.
Once you leave town, the downward entrance back into this town is at 47,82.
At 44,86 there is a merchant who sells only matsutake.
Other than that, you can just pick up items, and there are trees, and
it is an oddly shaped open area all the way to the upward entrance of Arkhaia City at 34,124.
If you want to head straight to Arkhaia City, a possible route is: 10 to the left, up until you bump into something, 3 to the left, up until you bump into something.
Our Great Adventure: The Mystery Building
When you first enter, you are at 57,68.
From here, go right, then up until you bump into something, one to the left, then up until you bump into something,
and you can't go any further unless you pick up the matches at 60,78, facing left.
Pass under the stone tablet at 64,71, go right,
and light the candle to the right of 72,71 to go to 76,71.
Above 79,71 is a Warp Panel to go back to the previous area.
Smash the wall above 81,71 with the hammer, and you can enter an area with three candles and a Warp Panel you can't use yet.
Light the candle to the right of 81,73, warp to 85,73, pick up the red shard below 86,73, and use the thing to the right of 90,73 to go back to the previous area.
Light the candle to the right of 81,76, warp to 85,76, pick up the blue shard right next to it on the right, and use the thing to the right of 89,76 to go back to the previous area.
Light the candle to the right of 81,78, warp to 85,78, pick up the yellow shard to the right of 91,80, and use the thing at 90,78 to go back to the previous area.
You can do the three lines above in any order, but you have to do all of them.
Now the Warp Panel at 80,77 works, and using it starts a mini-boss fight.
After the mini-boss fight, you'd better assume you have no idea where in this area you'll end up.
From here, go to 79,87 and use the Warp Panel(?) above it to warp to 79,90.
Go five up and seven right to 86,95, and smash the wall above you by hitting it 60 times within 10 seconds. If you hit it too slowly, it's game over, so watch out!
Go to 81,97, press Enter, and rescue the child.
Go up, then right, each time until you bump into something, and light the candle at 86,100 to warp to 90,100.
There is a Warp Panel at 94,100, but using it sends you back, so unless you want to farm EXP in this building, it's best to ignore it.
From 96,100, go up until you bump into something, and on the right there is a Warp Panel. Using it lets you escape this building.
You land in the pool at your home. When you take the child home, it's probably a good idea to talk to your friends at the front door of your home first.
Even after escaping, you can come back to the Mystery Building as many times as you like(?). Of course, there's no mini-boss.
Our Great Adventure: Arkhaia City, and Beyond
The first time you enter, there is a merchant above 34,136, straight ahead from the entrance. Talk to him and you end up buying a Long Sword.
After that, talk to the police officer at 45,134, go home, and warp to the Evil Mansion from the blackboard-eraser cleaner.
After finishing that event, come back to Arkhaia City and it is back to normal. Ask the merchant at the spot above to step aside, and you can go into town.
At 28,139 there is the entrance to the department store above you. Inside, it is like the 14 lines below.
25,144: the department store's 1st floor food section.
Above 29,149: stairs up to the 2nd floor.
21,160: the department store's 2nd floor restaurant.
Below 29,153: stairs down to the 1st floor.
Above 28,159: stairs up to the 3rd floor.
Above 24,168: the department store's 3rd floor weapons and armour section. It has the new weapons, the Whip and the Bronze Knife.
Below 28,163: stairs down to the 2nd floor.
Above 28,168: stairs up to the 4th floor.
20,171: the department store's 4th floor photo booth.
22,177: also there, the drum game.
27,179: also there, the claw machine.
Below 28,172: stairs down to the 3rd floor.
Elsewhere in the department store there are customers(?).
The department store exit is at 28,141.
At 48,174 there is the entrance to a hotel, below you.
Other than that, this town has several houses with people in them and flower beds all over, and the paths are a bit complicated.
For a rough route from the Crystal City entrance to the other side: go up to 34,139, then go left, up, left, up, left, up, right, down, right, each time until you bump into something, and the exit is above you.
At 62,175 there is an exit out of town above you, but
the first time you leave through it, the mini-boss Megasaurus shows up.
The first time you step on 67,189 in the top right corner, the mini-boss Ultra Gakishonen appears.
Beat him, and a path going up opens. Go up, left, up, right,
to 69,193. Above you is a rock. Place the key on it, and
the code
1u4l2u7r2d3r1u4l3u5r1d1r3d
is shown, and you warp to the other side of the wall.
From the other side of the wall, there is a rock below 69,195, so you can come back with it.
Also, the moment you step onto 77,202, you are warped to Yamijin's room. There is no warning sound at all here, no items or doors, and you can't even have this coordinate read out, so you need to check carefully as you go around here.
You absolutely have to go to Yamijin's room, or the story won't move on.
Our Great Adventure: The Evil Mansion
You start at 48,135.
Keep going right, and poking 57,135 starts the ball dodging.
It ends at 60,135.
Go up until you bump into something, then right. From 62,138, one step to the right starts a mini-boss fight,
and after the mini-boss fight you are at 62,138.
Then go through the door at 63,138, go right, then up, each time until you bump into something, and above you there is a wall you can smash.
Go down to 72,140, then one step up to 72,141, and swing the Long Sword there and it breaks easily, but if you get any closer before smashing it, you get killed.
Go up until you bump into something, then right to 79,149, and press Enter for the second round of ball dodging.
It ends at 82,149.
Go up until you bump into something, then right to 86,155, and one more step right starts a mini-boss fight.
After the mini-boss fight, go right, then up, each time until you bump into something, and to the right of 89,157 there is a door.
Open this door and, yes, another mini-boss fight.
The mini-boss fight ends at 91,157.
Go to 94,158 and there is a Warp Panel on the right. You land to the left of the blackboard eraser at your home.
From this point on, Arkhaia City is back to normal.
This dungeon only appears once.
Our Great Adventure: Flame Town
When you first enter the town, it is a terrible mess, with Super Gakishonen all over the place, and you have to wipe them all out.
The town exit on the Flame Mountain side is 94,305.
Also, you can always shop with the merchant above 89,304 in this town.
This merchant has the new weapons, the Buster Blade and the Arrow Shot.
Stand next to the following coordinates, from above, below, left or right, and talk, and you battle a Super Gakishonen.
82,293
87,270

That should be 21 of them, but once you beat 20, it says: "Here lies what was once a Gakishonen.", and it seems one of them stays without disappearing.
After finishing the event above, you can go out on the Flame Mountain side.
For a route from the Yamijin's room side to the Flame Mountain side, the easiest is probably five to the left from where you entered, then up until you bump into something.
Note that in this town, during and after the event, you can't run away from any battle.
Outside town, you are at 94,310.
To get to Flame Mountain from here, one route is: up, right, each time until you bump into something, one down, then right, up, left, up, right, each time until you bump into something, eight down, then right, up, each time until you bump into something.
At 138,311 there is a merchant.
Our Great Adventure: Starting the Game
The game starts at 1,1.
From here, go up, right, down, right, each time until you bump into something, and partway up,
at 5,9, go through the door on the right into the storeroom.
At least open the treasure chest at 7,1 and take out the key, and get the washtub at 9,13. Without the key you can't get to the exit of your home, and the washtub is armour.
There are slingshot balls lying all over too, so it's a good idea to pick them up.
Leave the storeroom, go up until you bump into something, two to the left, and go out upward through the door at 3,13 into the corridor.
In the corridor, go left, then up, each time until you bump into something, then right to 8,18, then up, right, down, each time until you bump into something,
then two to the right and two up, and go up through the door at 12,27,
then one more up, left until you bump into something, and face down. There is a hammer, so take it.
Also take the wooden slingshot at 9,34. Without it, you can't shoot slingshot balls.
There are a few other items too.
At 7,44 there is a window on the left. Any time before you set off on your journey is fine, but smash it with the hammer. If you don't, you can't leave your home.
Go back to where your room is, and go to 5,48 while avoiding walls(?) and things. There is a recessed door below you. Smash it with the hammer and go in, and you can get lots of sweet buns and slingshot balls, but
be careful not to press Enter at 15,6, 16,5, 15,4, 15,2 and 16,1. Any items you haven't picked up get blown away, and depending on the spot it's game over, and even if it isn't, your HP drops to 1.
Press Enter at 5,48, following the winding path past the window you smashed, and your friends at home are waiting to see you off. The first time, they give you items.
Go left from there, bump into the wall with the up arrow, then press Enter, and you can go out the front door.
Near your room, at 5,16, there is a sofa that restores 10 HP, so it's worth learning the route between the exit of your home and this sofa. Early on, it's a good way to save healing items.
Also, the blackboard-eraser cleaner at 9,16 will later become a warp device.

omake2.doc.last_dungeon:
Our Great Adventure: The Complete Last Dungeon Guide!
The last dungeon starts straight away with a fight against Yamijin. After that, it's probably better to finish him off.
Right after the Yamijin fight, you are at 174,304.
From here, go left, then up as far as you can, and there is a door.
Through the door, you are at 172,313.
Next, go up, right, up, and there are three windows. Smash them and a path opens upwards; smash the window that eventually appears on the right and keep going.
At 174,333 it widens up and to the right, but go right.
At 178,333 there is a window blocking the path that leads(?) to the right.
At 186,333, three Beam Machines appear. Maybe this is the mini-boss for this section? Beat them and a path up appears.
From 186,337 on, it is an open area.
There are doors at 180,346, 200,340 and 187,349.
Go through the door at 180,346 and there is a key lying at 173,349, so pick it up.
Go through the door at 200,340 and there are lots of sweet buns,
but if you destroy the one at 212,340 instead of picking it up, you can go down.
There is a key lying at 212,336, so pick it up.
Ignore 211,341.
Ignore 212,342.
Go through the door at 187,349, then up, right, down, right, up, right, down, and at 193,351 there is a door on the right where you can get some healing items.
Without going that far, partway along the first path going up, at 187,353, there is a path to the left.
Follow it left, then up, and there is a door at 185,356.
Go in and straight up, and there is another door at 185,370.
Go through that door and a little way up, and you fight the mini-boss kissenon.
Go up, and from 185,377 on there is an open area that is a bit cluttered on the right.
In the top left corner of this area there are two items.
There is a door at 194,389. Go in facing up, and it opens out in front of you, with a path continuing to the bottom right.
At 196,382 there is a door leading right.
At 196,377 there is a door leading down.
Both lead to the room on the right.
That room only lets you go right through the door at 199,380, and there is nothing in it.
Through the door, there is a path going up from 208,380. If you go up, there is a door on the right. If you go straight on without going up, there is also a door on the right.
The upper door takes you there directly, and the door at the far right takes you through a small room with a door out to the right, and you come out in the same room on the right.
In this room, poking 218,382 starts the ball dodging.
In the area where the ball dodging ends, poking 222,384 sends you back to the place nine lines up from here.
At 223,382 there is a door out to the right. Go through it, and
at 227,382 and 228,382 there are doors facing down. Either one leads to the same area.
Here, markers of four colours are scattered around, and there are doors all over the place.
If you step on 239,379, something seems to happen, and you hear a big boooom. Maybe it's better to step on it?
Past the upward exits at 229,390 and 230,390: game over.
Past the upward exit at 234,390: game over.
Past the downward exit at 240,390: game over.
Past the downward exit at 230,370: game over.
Past the downward exit at 236,370, you can pick up some shards of light.
Past the upward exit at 240,390, going up to 240,398, there is a wide path that turns back to the right.
Partway along this path, at 243,371, there is a door facing right.
Go through the door, straight right, cut down the sabon tree, pick up the fruit, and go to the end, and at 252,371 there is a door facing up.
Go through it and smash the windows to the left and right of 252,380. On the right there are healing items and a pointless(?) window,
and on the left there is a door, and at the very back, at 245,398, there is a futon that works just like a hotel.
From 252,380, keep going up to the end and go through the door at 252,387,
then go up one more and you fight Kuroro.
Charge down the one-way path on the right, and at the end, at 259,388, there is a door.
Go through it and up until you bump into something, and a path stretches to the left. On the right is something like a small open area.
At 255,390 there is a Warp Panel going up, but unless you unequip your weapon, you can't get through properly.
Also, once you've been through it and come back from this warp spot: without a weapon equipped, you go back to where the Kuroro fight was; with a weapon equipped, I haven't checked where you end up.
At 255,397 there is a Warp Panel, and here too you must not have a weapon equipped.
From 255,401, there is a complicated open area on the right.
Go to its right edge, and look for a way up by moving left and right a little at a time. When you get up to 264,407, you hear a door to the left, so head that way.
Go through the door at 263,407, and at 257,407 there is a three-way junction.
At 254,407 there is a door leading left, and at the back you get a little hint.
At 257,412 there is a door facing up, and it is a tricky contraption just like the hint in the room on the left.
Go through upward three times, and
at 257,418 there is a window on the left and a door above.
Go through the upper door, and at 255,420 there is a door facing up that takes you out at 255,422. On the way back, go down through the door at 255,422, and 257,420 has turned into a window, so you have to break it, just once.
Or smash the window on the left, go left to the end and then up, and at 255,420 there is a door facing up that takes you out at 255,422. On the way back, go down through the door at 255,422, down to 255,418, then right to the end and face down.
Do either of the two lines above and go down through three doors to get back to 257,412, but where you actually want to go next is 255,422.
From 255,422 on, it is a pretty big open area.
At the right edge, at 272,423, there is a door. Inside is a straight path, and at 282,423 there are two mini-boss fights.
Go up, and at 272,428 there is a door. Inside is a straight path, and at 281,428 there are two mini-boss fights.
Coming up from the bottom left, at 241,428, there is a door. Inside is a straight path, and at 230,428 there are two mini-boss fights.
Go up, and at 241,436 there is a door. Inside is a straight path, and at 226,436 there is a mini-boss fight.
I haven't checked whether the four lines above are exactly right. What happens if you go through these doors in a different order? Anyway, it seems certain that there are seven mini-boss fights in a row here.
Once you finish the seven mini-boss fights in a row, you can go through the door at 255,440. It's the only door left.
This place is full of dressers, tables and vases, and over on the right there are some sweet buns.
Go in, move up until you bump into something, then go five to the left, and there is a door at 250,446.
Go through this door, go up the wide room until you bump into something,
then press Enter at the far right, at 275,450, for some ball dodging.
Here, when two balls come flying, you have to pick the direction that dodges both of them, and the balls come faster and faster.
When you finish the ball dodging, you are at 275,446. Move down and right to 276,430, and there is a door facing right.
Go through the door. At 280,432 there is a machine with three buttons. Check your ball count with the blue button, and fire 255 slingshot balls into this machine. Then the door at 283,436 opens, but note that once you go through it, you can't save until the very end.
Yokotank is here. Beat him in two fights in a row and you get to see the ending.

 When you clear everything, a special file, replay_tempsavedata.dat, is created. Without renaming it, start play.exe and let it generate save data for the replay,
and from then on you enter the replay using the generated save data.
After the replay starts, you can change the mode at the desk at 10,10 in the storeroom of your home.
Oh, and some of this is a... lie! Hee hee!
omake2.doc.multi_ending:
Our Great Adventure: How the Multiple Endings Work!
This game has two endings. Needless to say, the good ending and the bad ending.
The ending branches at a certain point.
That point is whether or not you kill Yamijin.
If you kill him, you get the bad ending.
And here's a cheat for you.
1. Press Control+Tab.
2. Type kill all monster! and press Enter.
Then no enemies appear until you move to a different area.
omake1.doc.stun:
Our Great Adventure: Huh? The Enemy...
Well, well, congratulations on clearing Hell mode. Today I've brought some fun info for all of you who worked so hard in Hell mode.
It's called the Enemies-Can't-Move-So-You-Can-Pin-Them-Down-Yay-Yay Attack, now renamed the Blunt-Edge Strike!!
What you need is the Short Sword or the Long Sword. When you swing it, try holding down the Shift key as you swing. Oh, during battle, of course.
The rest is a surprise for when you try it. Oh, yes, yes. Do take note that it doesn't work in No Future mode, darling. Oh-ho-ho-ho-hoooo!
omake1.doc.damage:
Our Great Adventure: See the Damage, Yay!
This time, since you watched the good ending, I'll show you a fun cheat.
Steps
1. Hold Control and press Tab.
2. Type damage message on or damage message off (as you can see, it switches it on and off)
Then just quickly press Enter and go fight.
Then the damage the enemy just took is shown. How much damage is getting through to the enemy, and so on. I think it's a good reference.
Well then, see ya laaater!
omake1.doc.fastwalk:
Our Great Adventure: Dash Like Crazy!
This time, I'll show you a cheat for dashing around the field at top speed.
Steps
1. Hold Control and press Tab.
2. Type fastwalk.
3. Press Enter and try your new dish... I mean dash! Oops, wrong word!
It goes away when you reload. But it's pretty handy sometimes.
replay.offer: Congratulations. It looks like you've cleared the whole game. In this game, you can play again, carrying over your status, money and items. However, in the current version, it is not 100% guaranteed that all data carries over. Do you want to replay?
replay.declined: I see. You won't play. Then, so that this data is never used for a replay, may I delete it? Deleting it erases the data for replaying. Your save data from before clearing the game is not affected.
replay.generating: Now generating the data for the replay. Press Enter and please wait a moment.
replay.choose_slot: Choose a slot to save the replay data in.
replay.restart: Returning to the title screen. Choose Load in the title menu and load slot {slot}.
